children: HONG KONG, Sept. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KLN Logistics Group Limited ('KLN'; Stock Code 0636.HK) and SATS Ltd. ('SATS'; Stock Code S58.SI) jointly announced that KLN Freight International Limited ('KLN Freight'), a subsidiary of KLN, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with SATS, one of the world's leading providers of air cargo handling services. The parties will explore strategic collaborations to strengthen the global supply chain connectivity, improve operational efficiency and develop innovative logistics solutions for customers worldwide.

The strategic partnership will combine KLN's freight forwarding and logistics capabilities with SATS' global network and air cargo handling expertise to jointly develop and scale solutions across their combined networks in Asia, Europe and the Americas, creating greater connectivity and efficiency across the end-to-end supply chain.

As an initial step, KLN and SATS will focus on two strategic initiatives under their value-added service offerings: end-to-end temperature-controlled handling solutions to support the transport and storage of sensitive cargo and the expedited handling of time-critical shipments that require speed, precision and reliability.

Wong Siew Loong, Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer of KLN, said, "For time-critical and sensitive cargo such as healthcare shipments, every touchpoint in the supply chain is critical to safeguarding patient safety and service continuity. Through this MOU, our partnership with SATS leverages our complementary strengths to reinforce network resilience, enhance shipment visibility and advance service standards across our global operations. We are committed to delivering faster, more reliable and sustainable logistics solutions that provide greater assurance, agility and value for customers worldwide."

Martin Holme, Chief Commercial Officer of SATS, said, "This partnership reflects SATS' commitment to creating value through closer collaboration across the logistics ecosystem. Building on our experience in improving cargo visibility, streamlining operations and supporting time-critical shipments, we look forward to working with KLN to develop solutions that deliver greater efficiency and service excellence for customers. Singapore will be the first station for these initiatives, serving as a launchpad for solutions that can be scaled across our respective global networks."
About KLN Logistics Group Limited (Stock Code 0636.HK)

KLN is an Asia-rooted, global 3PL delivering customer-centric, end-to-end supply chain solutions that connect markets and power global trade, as a trusted partner to many of the top 100 global brands and Fortune Global 500 companies across a wide spectrum of industries. With a presence across 59 countries and territories, KLN offers integrated logistics, international freight forwarding, e-commerce and industrial project logistics solutions. KLN has been the global No. 1 Trans-Pacific NVOCC from Asia to the US since 2023 and ranks No. 20 among Global 3PLs (Armstrong & Associates, 2026). Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, KLN generated revenue* of over HK$56 billion in 2025 and is a constituent of the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index. Learn more at www.kln.com

) is one of the world's leading providers of air cargo handling services and Asia's leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. SATS Food Solutions serves airlines and institutions, and operates central kitchens with large-scale food production and distribution capabilities for a wide range of cuisines. SATS is present in the Asia-Pacific, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, powering an interconnected world of trade, travel and taste. Following the acquisition of Worldwide Flight Services (WFS) in 2023, the combined SATS and WFS network operates over 225 stations in 27 countries. These cover trade routes responsible for more than 50% of global air cargo volume. SATS has been listed on the Singapore Exchange since May 2000. For more information, please visit www.sats.com.sg
